source.detail: The author reports having verified removal of this pair and the historical 149 versus current 148 Linalg Level 2 counts. The historical snapshot and its eight judge scores have not been recovered in this artifact.

local_reference_search: No excluded-pair rows were found in the current artifact master/reasoning/evaluation files or the older local Supabase master/judge-evaluations/evaluation-HF JSON exports.
interpretation: The Level 2 dataset change is a likely explanation for the eight older-model Level 2 differences. Exact per-model numerical attribution requires the eight original judge scores and confirmation of the historical aggregation procedure.
unrelated_difference: GPT-OSS L4 is a separate rounding discrepancy; it is not explained by the Level 2 pair removal.
preservation: The excluded pair is not restored, missing judge scores are not inferred, published labels and paper expectations are unchanged, and affected comparisons remain visible as MISMATCH.
